status: Exploratory component validation; specified before execution, not a preregistration
selection: All sampled final-closure commits with an exact matched merged PR and a locally available official commit. This selects two cases from five final-closure pointers.
sampling_scope: Purposive, source-available cases; no repair-prevalence or general maintenance-effect estimate
conditions: Use official repair commit and its first parent in isolated source archives
Require identical go.mod and go.sum within each pair
Run identical regression oracles on both variants and preserve normal-case controls
Treat build failures and missing test executions as inconclusive, not reproduced defects
Keep actual human coding forms unchanged

cases.oracle_source: Researcher component fixture based on the report's two-user laptop/server rename scenario
cases.claim_boundary: RenameNode rejects a duplicate given name without changing the node; DNS resolution on the original Debian/Tailscale deployment is not replayed

cases.oracle_source: Exact upstream regression test file from the repair commit, applied unchanged to both variants
cases.claim_boundary: FilterNodesByACL peer visibility for a /32 ACL within a /16 advertised route; original Kubernetes subnet-router traffic and PostgreSQL access are not replayed
